```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Every State has an office dealing with veterans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The federal Department needs to consider State veterans' offices as partners in assisting veterans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Those closest to individual veterans can best diagnose a problem and apply a remedy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This is especially important with regard to the determination of veterans' disability claims.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Private insurance companies can deal with car wrecks and hurricanes within weeks or months.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The federal government takes, on average, a year to process a veteran's claim.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Urgence of immediate action to review the automatic denial of gun ownership to returning members of the Armed Forces who have had representatives appointed to manage their financial affairs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has participated in a wide range of international organizations since the end of World War II.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"International organizations can serve the cause of peace and prosperity, but sometimes do not.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United States must always reserve the right to go its own way while acting through international organizations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"There can be no substitute for principled American leadership.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
